title: 第三章刀疤脸是好人
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵宇不知道黎雾的自信是怎么来的。

他和陆云铮两人，一个走在最前面，一个殿后，黎雾走中间，远远的跟在刀疤脸的身后，朝城中村深处走去。

五分钟后

眼看着刀疤脸即将走进一个小院，陆云铮回头朝赵宇点了点头，赵宇颔首示意，两人快步向前，突然开口道：

“你好，例行检查，配合一下。”

突然响起的警察声让刀疤脸身体骤然一僵，扭头看到的就是陆云铮递到面前的证件，还有男人不容置疑的神色。

眼神中闪过一丝凶狠，不知道想到了什么，眸中的凶狠很快褪去，转而搓了搓手，一脸热切快速道：

“警官，你们怎么来了。”

“上次不是已经检查过了吗？”

“我们家没什么问题，都是大大的好人。”

赵宇脸上神色丝毫未变，虽然搞不懂黎雾为什么会空口白牙说刀疤脸才是凶手，但是来都来了，总要检查一遍。

淡定道：

“例行检查，麻烦配合一下。”

刀疤脸脸上神色没有丝毫变得，反而唇角勾起了一抹势在必得的得意弧度。

往后退了一步，连连点头道：

“好好好，警官，我们肯定配合。”

“你慢慢查，我们家绝对没有任何问题。”

看到刀疤脸这没有丝毫惶恐的模样，黎雾心里咯噔一声。

难道真是她误会了什么？

没忍住抬眼朝刀疤脸头上看去，依旧是标红加粗的【绑架案凶手】五个大字。

正沉思间，陆云铮冷静的提醒声响起：

“看路。”

黎雾连忙敛神，跟在陆云铮身边，目光朝屋内摆设看去。

这一看，她的心瞬间就凉了。

昏杂逼仄的室内，一眼看得到头的摆设，乱七八糟的堆放着各种杂物。

东西虽然多，但是有眼睛的人都能看出来，这个屋子里并不具备藏纳一个人的地方。

黎雾咽了咽口水。

难不成真的是她搞错了。

这刀疤脸真是一个好人？

或许她真的应该去精神科看看。

黎雾心中后悔自己非要拖着让陆云铮追上来，现在反而出了一个大大的洋相。

Page (1/3)

Zhao Yu didn't know where Li Wu's confidence came from.

He and Lu Yunzheng, one walked in front and the other in the back, Li Wu walked in the middle, following Scarface from a distance, walking towards the depths of the village in the city.

five minutes later

Seeing that Scarface was about to walk into a small courtyard, Lu Yunzheng turned around and nodded to Zhao Yu. Zhao Yu nodded and signaled. The two of them walked forward quickly and suddenly said:

"Hello, it's a routine inspection. Please cooperate."

The sudden sound of police officers made Scarface stiffen suddenly. He turned around and saw the ID that Lu Yunzheng handed to him, as well as the man's unquestionable expression.

A trace of ferocity flashed in his eyes, and he didn't know what he thought of. The ferocity in his eyes quickly faded away, and he rubbed his hands instead, and said quickly with an eager expression:

"Officer, why are you here?"

"Didn't you check it last time?"

"There is nothing wrong with our family. They are all good people."

The expression on Zhao Yu's face didn't change at all. Although he didn't understand why Li Wu would say that Scarface was the murderer, he still had to check it after he came.

He said calmly:

"Routine inspection, please cooperate."

The expression on Scarface's face did not change at all, but the corners of his lips curved up with a hint of triumph.

He took a step back, nodded repeatedly and said:

"Okay, okay, officer, we will definitely cooperate."

"Check it out slowly. There is absolutely nothing wrong with our family."

Seeing the lack of fear on Scar's face, Li Wu's heart skipped a beat.

Did she really misunderstand something?

I couldn't help but look up at Scar's face. There were still five big characters "Kidnapping Murderer" marked in red and bold.

While he was deep in thought, Lu Yunzheng's calm reminder sounded:

"Watch the road."

Li Wu quickly gathered his attention and followed Lu Yunzheng, looking at the furnishings in the room.

At this sight, her heart instantly dropped.

In the dark and cramped room, you can see all kinds of furnishings and various sundries piled up in a mess.

Although there are many things, anyone with eyes can see that there is no place to hide a person in this room.

Li Wu swallowed.

Could it be that she really made a mistake.

Is this Scarface really a good person?

Maybe she really should go to a psychiatrist.

Li Wu regretted in his heart that he had to drag Lu Yunzheng to catch up, but now he made a big fool of himself.
